generation.prompt:
Create a production sprite atlas for an original Heroes of Might and Magic III additional creature, hand-painted 2D with the compact detailed pixel appearance of the 1999 game. Subject: Chem-Golem, a gigantic LIVING Zaun human augmented by industrial chemtech. Clearly visible natural tan/grey human flesh over huge muscular chest, neck, arms, thighs, scarred bald human face and stern expression; ordinary human head, no robot head. Rust-brown leather straps, plum-purple loincloth, partial dark bronze limb braces and huge metal striking cuffs; two contained bright chemical-green fluid bottles at the upper back joined with hoses. Bare muscular anatomy remains majority of body. No box torso or fully metal shell, no champion likeness. Visible Zaun region respirator-mask crest painted on the plum belt tab: angular mask with narrow eyes and two round cheek filters, small at native scale. Powerful but grounded, heavy two-footed human. Three-quarter side view facing right, original HoMM3 battle camera, light upper left, restrained highlights, fully opaque painted body, transparent background and soft small contact shadow. Same single character identity, same outfit, scale and perspective across every frame. Each pose must be genuinely different anatomical action, not copies or translations. No text, grid lines, labels, scenery, floor slab, glow outline, watermark, weapons, wings or model render.

EXACT ATLAS LAYOUT: 1536 by 1536 square, six equal columns and six equal rows (each cell 256x256). One isolated COMPLETE full-body sprite per cell, generous 32px transparent margins all sides, no body crossing cells. Same apparent body height about190px, feet approximately y220 within each cell. All right-facing except stated turn/encounter. Read left-to-right:
ROW1 six consecutive heavy WALK cycle phases: left heel contact, left foot plant/right heel lift, passing, right heel contact, right foot plant/left heel lift, opposite passing. Articulated shoulders/hips/knees/ankles.
ROW2 columns1-4 four subtle alert/ready poses with breathing and looking right; col5 neutral standing battle HOLD pose; col6 full body standing portrait pose, grounded.
ROW3 col1-4 four recoil HIT phases: strike impact, backward bend, recovering, upright. col5 independent small-map full-body right-facing stance. col6 independent left-facing lunging encounter illustration.
ROW4 col1-4 four TURN-to-front phases, starting right-facing neutral then quarter turn chest toward camera then more front then full front with both feet planted; preserve head/body correspondence. col5 independent right-facing lunging encounter illustration; col6 quiet neutral portrait pose.
ROW5 col1-4 four DEFEND phases: brace, lift thick forearms protect chest, absorb impact, recover. col5-6 neutral stance variants.
ROW6 six DEATH phases: stagger, knees buckle, kneel, fall forward, hit ground, fully fallen low horizontal corpse. Corpse completely fits within cell, no standing remnant.

Artwork must read as textured 2D Heroes III native sprites when reduced to roughly85px body height. Plain transparent background. Not glossy modern 3D, not vector, not anime, not chibi. Preserve a believable heavy organic human and equipment through every action.
